body:
**For maintainer review: the consensus threshold.**

This fallback accepts an axis when **75 %** of the answering surface meets the consensus line (`CONSENSUS_SHARE` in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis_consensus.rs`). The plain gate needs 90 %, and the robust pass's backstop is 50 %. The contributor isn't positioned to judge the right number, so this needs your call. Two things limit the risk:

- The fallback runs only when no candidate passes the plain 90 % gate. Every part that fitted before gets exactly the same fit, and no golden changed.
- The off-axis-lump (30 % of the surface) and box cases are still refused by name (pinned in `axis_consensus_tests` and `lathe_spindle_keyed`).

If you want a different share, it is one constant; the tests pin both sides of it. Flagging the PR ready so it reaches your queue. The rest is in `docs/decisions/113-lathe-axis-fit.md`.
